name: Self-advancing goals
principle: Goals keep moving between a person's sessions, because the work they delegated gets done to the standard they wrote.
state_description: You schedule an AI task the way you schedule a goal, and at that time it happens: grounded, finished to its written standard, reported against the goal, with your attention asked for only where it is needed.
hints_of_measurement: Delegated tasks finish to their written standard without rework.

name: Personally grounded help
principle: Every answer and action rests on the person's own goals, material and preferences, and never on another person's.
state_description: Asking Quest AI feels like asking a colleague who has read everything relevant to you, says only what your material supports, and never mentions anyone else's.
hints_of_measurement: Replies state the facts the account holds, state nothing it does not, and nothing crosses scope.

name: Trusted autonomy
principle: The AI acts first on what it may decide and brings the person exactly the decisions that are theirs.
state_description: Work moves without you, and when a question reaches you it is one only you should answer, with what you need to answer it.
hints_of_measurement: No human-only step is taken alone, and few asks turn out to be unnecessary.

name: One shared engine
principle: One domain-free engine serves every consumer, every lane and both chat and scheduled work, and differs only in configuration.
state_description: A new product or team gets grounded, escalating AI help by supplying configuration and adapters, and every improvement reaches everyone who uses it.
hints_of_measurement: Consumers add little glue of their own and copy none of the engine.

name: Metric-led evolution
principle: Every part of QAR improves as the state of the art moves, with the best implementation chosen by its metric.
state_description: When a better model, method or tool appears, it is measured against the current one on the same cases and becomes the default if it wins, without a rewrite.
hints_of_measurement: Every part has a current measured result, and selections follow the measurements.

name: Visible value
principle: What AI work costs and how good it is are known before they surprise anyone.
state_description: Operators see cost per result and quality per part as they go, budgets hold, and a drop in quality shows up in a metric before it shows up in a complaint.
hints_of_measurement: Every run reports its cost, and every part has a quality metric with a recent result.
